description: This PHP file defines the LanguageAPI class, which provides RESTful API endpoints for managing Language entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting language records, with validation and documentation annotations.

classes.name: LanguageAPI
classes.description: This class provides CRUD API endpoints for managing language entities, including fetching individual or lists of languages, creating new language entries, updating existing ones, and deleting languages. It handles validation rules, service invocation, and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getLanguageService
methods.description: Returns an instance of LanguageService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single language record based on the provided ID, returns it as a modeled resource.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of all language records, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new language record using input parameters, returns the created model.

methods.name: saveLanguage
methods.description: Assigns the name from request parameters to the Language entity and saves it via the service.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing language record identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for fetching a single language by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing languages with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new language, primarily the 'name' field.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a language, including unique name validation.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for the 'name' parameter, including length and uniqueness constraints.

params.name: uniqueOption
params.description: Optional parameter to specify ignore ID for uniqueness check.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes language records identified by provided IDs, returning list of deleted IDs.
